argv: import importlib.metadata as m; assert m.version('pydantic_core') == '2.27.2'

doc.title: Migrate the custom Money type to Pydantic 2.10.6/pydantic-core 2.27.2. Keep Money(amount, currency), its amount/currency attributes and make_adapter(). The adapter must accept an existing Money instance unchanged in Python mode, or a mapping with exactly amount and currency, in both Python and JSON mode. amount must be a strict string in canonical signed decimal form with exactly two fractional digits, no leading zeros except zero itself, no exponent or whitespace; negatives are allowed. currency must be USD/EUR. Invalid mappings, numbers, booleans, nonfinite values, extra/missing keys and arbitrary strings must raise Pydantic ValidationError. Store amount as Decimal without float conversion. Serialize to {'amount': fixed-two-place string, 'currency': currency} in both dump_python and dump_json. TypeAdapter(list[Money]) must work. Generated JSON schema must describe the mapping, require both fields, forbid extras, expose a string amount pattern and enumerate currencies. Use supported core-schema hooks, not a v1 validator workaround.
